title: Sentient Amulet (Rare)

sources.title: Help the Spirit of the Amulet

summary: Amulet casts Shatter and restores Ki.

fields.Shatter: Action, 60 ft range, 10 ft radius. Deals 3d8 Thunder, Constitution save for half. Inorganic targets save with Disadvantage. Recharges on a Short Rest.
fields.Ki Restoration: Action on yourself once per Long Rest. Restores 2 Ki Points.
fields.High Spirits: Shatter prompts DC 10 Wisdom save. Failure knocks you Prone with Hysterical for 1 turn. Three successes can trigger a camp/equip scene. Failing that DC 10 save raises future DC to 15. After three more successes, failing a second scene’s DC 15 save raises it to 20. Ki Restoration prompts no save.
fields.Acquisition: Locked Adamantine Chest near the Lava Elemental in Grymforge. Picking it up starts Help the Cursed Monk.
fields.Base value: 125 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
